assertion: It’s not unusual for Louisiana to be among the first to see flu season surges each year. That is at least partly due to low vaccination rates, high poverty rates and challenges people face in accessing healthcare

inaccuracy: Lopez says Louisiana has low vaccination rates; BRFSS 65+ flu-shot coverage is 64.3% in Louisiana versus 67.7% nationally, only slightly below average and well above Mississippi's 59.7%.
sql: SELECT state, AVG(CAST(pct AS DOUBLE)) FROM health.cdc_brfss WHERE question LIKE 'Adults aged 65+ who have had a flu shot%' AND response='Yes' AND break_out='Overall' AND "year"='2022' GROUP BY state
